General.growing_tip: Cover crops (green manure) serve 4 functions: erosion protection, soil structuring (deep roots), nitrogen fixation (legumes via Rhizobium), and feeding the soil web. Allow 8-10 weeks of growth minimum. Mow just before flowering for maximum N contribution. After mowing: cover with silage tarp ~2 weeks before planting. Mix legumes + cereals; seed at ≥1/4 bucket per 100ft (30m) bed to outcompete weeds. For compacted soils: broadfork deep + add 2in compost + cover crop for 10+ weeks.
General.rotation_companion: Inoculate legume seeds with Rhizobium bacteria if legumes haven't been grown in that bed for some time. Good combination: legumes (vetch, clover) + cereals (oats, rye). Add Ramial Wood Chips in walkways for fungal element. Avoid continuous tillage — maintain permabed system with cover crops to protect soil web between cash crop cycles.
